name: RoomPrecompiledStats
description: Status block with precompiled room information.

MessyBool.description: Boolean that often shows up as an integer or double in the file

pathing_items.description: Bitmask of items (items required to arrive here?)

combat.description: True if this Room is considered to be a 'combat room'.

items.description: Count of item pickup locations in the Room.

potential_major.description: True if there was a major item pickup location in the original room design(?)

elevators.description: An array of two values: The number of elevators pointing up, and the number of elevators pointing down.

enemy_types.description: List of enemy Id's for all enemies found in the room.

boss.description: Enemy Id for the boss in this room if there is one. Otherwise -1.

liquid_types.description: This is supposed to be an array, but it is an integer in practice.

block_types.description: This is supposed to be an array, but it is an integer in practice.

items.description: Integer triplets, possibly xyz coordinates? But why??
